findings.title: Okta security advisories - CVE-2026-85982 advisory listing
findings.summary_md: The Okta Trust advisory page lists the stored XSS vulnerability CVE-2026-85982 for the Auth0 AD/LDAP Connector with disclosure date Sep 8, 2026. It is the primary vendor confirmation of the flaw before the story's first_seen on Sep 11.

findings.title: GBHackers: Okta Patches Auth0 and Access Gateway Vulnerabilities
findings.summary_md: GBHackers reports the disclosure on September 8, 2026, covering stored XSS (CVE-2026-85982 with CVSS 9.0), authorization bypass, and SQL injection. It recommends upgrading auth0/ad-ldap-connector to version 8.0.0 or later.
